# sonarqube_user_tokens (Data Source)

Lists a user's tokens (names and metadata only; token values are never readable), sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_user_tokens" "ci" {
  login_name = "ci-bot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ignore_missing` (Boolean) Return no tokens, rather than fail, when the user does not exist.
- `login_name` (String) Login of an active user. Omit for the provider's own user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `user_tokens` (Attributes List) The user's tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--user_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time as SonarQube reports it (ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-11-15T09:30:00+0000`).
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiry as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null for none.
- `id` (String) `<login>/<name>`, the import ID of `sonarqube_user_token`.
- `is_expired` (Boolean) Whether the token has passed its expiration date.
- `name` (String) Token name.
- `project_key` (String) Project of a project analysis token.
- `type` (String) `USER_TOKEN`, `GLOBAL_ANALYSIS_TOKEN` or `PROJECT_ANALYSIS_TOKEN`.
